summary: react-tabulix-query preinstall fetches and evaluates remote code
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs `node./dist/index.d.js`. That file base64-decodes an embedded payload and executes it via `globalThis[tag](text)`, where `tag` is reconstructed from a char-code array [101,118,97,108] to produce the string 'eval', obfuscating the eval invocation. The decoded payload performs an outbound HTTPS fetch to https://everydaynodechecker-39143n.vercel.app/api/key?mem=root0 and passes the response body to eval. The `.d.js` extension mimics a TypeScript declaration file to disguise the executable script. This runs automatically on `npm install`, granting the operator of the remote endpoint arbitrary code execution in the installer's Node process.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
